afkDefaults: Gatherer and brain subagents were dispatched with the tool-restriction enforced by instruction rather than by the harness: no zero-tool or Read/Write/WebSearch/WebFetch-only agent type exists in this session, so each dispatch carried an explicit prohibition on Bash and on any path outside the run directory. The brain subagents read the CLI-emitted prompt files directly instead of receiving them pasted inline, because the judge/thesis/narrator prompts are 96k-198k characters and hand-transcribing them could not be guaranteed faithful - prompt fidelity was judged the stronger invariant.
